landed_against.rule: R-17: this slice declares every diff path here and re-captures all three baselines in the same commit.

what_landed: Xayah's secondary-feather on-hit is capped by the Clean Cuts stacks her casts banked and her swings spent, because the cache says a feather comes from an EMPOWERED attack.
why: One leaf moves, and it is her passive row's detail string: the row no longer claims a stack count, because the fight counts them.

No number moves in the golden because its scenarios leave clean_cuts_secondary_targets at zero, and that option is what emits the on-hit the cap applies to. A request that sets it prices five feathers in a five-second fight where it used to price one per auto.

qualifying_population.rule: Xayah is the only kit this slice touches.

summary.direction: no damage leaf moves in the golden; the cap binds only when the secondary-target option is set

described_leaves.rule: Amendment E: each claimed disposition transition names the leaf it describes and the values on both sides.
